title: The Unsolved Mathematics Atlas
description: A reproducible, ranked, FAIR-indexed research dossier of 106 open mathematical problems across 38 fields, paired with a standalone eight-domain, six-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal verification core with autoImplicit=false (53 headline theorems, 12 witnesses, 16 adversarial refutations, including full Lonely Runner through n=3, Euclid's even perfect number theorem for all p>=2, and exact Ramsey R(3,3)=6 & R(3,4)=9), live negative kernel rejection, automated primary-source citation and Crossref/DataCite retraction auditing, dual RFC 3161 + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proofs, RO-Crate 1.1 and Croissant 1.0 metadata, a compiled AMS-LaTeX white paper, and a deterministic RAG corpus. Independent research; not peer-reviewed.
notes: Dual-licensed: prose/data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE), code and Lean 4 formal proofs under MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Human author directed conceptualization, scoping, formal statement-fidelity auditing, and curation; AI tools were used as disclosed drafting/engineering instruments (see CLAIMS.md, ERRATA.md, and lean/formalization.yaml).
